theme_one.specific_theme: Reply speed and follow-up on customer inquiries
theme_one.definition: How quickly and reliably support answers questions across phone, email, and chatbot, including proactive follow-up.

theme_two.definition: The size, number, and clarity of fees charged for opening, changing, and closing accounts or financing.

theme_three.specific_theme: Portal functionality, speed, and data export
theme_three.definition: Quality of the online portal and mobile app, including login reliability, speed, modernity, and ability to download statements or CSV files.

theme_four.specific_theme: Time from invoice approval to payout
theme_four.definition: How fast funds are paid out after an invoice is submitted and approved.

theme_five.specific_theme: Consistency and clarity of rates, agreements, and decisions
theme_five.definition: Whether interest rates, agreement terms, and approval or rejection decisions are communicated clearly, consistently, and proactively.

theme_one.specific_theme: Actual processing speed vs advertised 'same-day' promises
theme_one.definition: How quickly applications, credit decisions and payouts are completed compared with the bank's marketing promises.

theme_two.specific_theme: Reply speed, callback reliability and staff tone across contacts
theme_two.definition: How fast, polite and consistent customer support is when customers reach out for help.

theme_three.midlevel_theme: Fees, rates and credit terms transparency
theme_three.specific_theme: Price competitiveness, fee disputes and unwarned changes to credit terms
theme_three.definition: How competitive and predictable the bank's fees, rates and credit conditions are, including disputed charges and changes made without warning.

theme_four.specific_theme: Everyday portal tasks, balance/statement accuracy and third-party integrations
theme_four.definition: Whether customers can reliably perform everyday tasks in the portal and trust displayed balances, statements and integrations.

theme_five.midlevel_theme: Product fit and dependability for small businesses
theme_five.specific_theme: Usefulness of overdraft and invoice products for micro-companies
theme_five.definition: Whether the credit products genuinely serve small firms' cash-flow needs and treat micro-businesses as seriously as larger clients.

theme_one.specific_theme: Quoted vs Actual Pricing and Rate Explanation
theme_one.definition: Whether quoted prices match agreements, how rates compare to competitors, and whether interest calculation and terms are clearly explained.

theme_two.specific_theme: Portal Stability, Data Loss, and Missing App
theme_two.definition: Reliability and functionality of digital channels, including session timeouts, lost form data, portal clarity, and lack of a mobile app.

theme_three.specific_theme: Approval Speed, Payout Delays, and Case Processing Time
theme_three.definition: How fast applications are approved, funds are disbursed, and routine changes (e.g., account number updates) are completed versus promised.

theme_four.specific_theme: Payment Deferrals and Season-Adapted Repayment Plans
theme_four.definition: The bank's willingness to adapt repayment schedules, grant deferrals, and show understanding when businesses face difficulties.

theme_five.specific_theme: Status Updates, Chatbot Limitations, and Reaching Staff
theme_five.definition: Whether customers are kept informed during processing, can reach a human when needed, and receive consistent, accurate answers.

theme_one.specific_theme: Speed of credit decisions and document handling
theme_one.definition: How quickly and smoothly financing applications are processed end-to-end, from instant weekend approvals to multi-week rejections and repeated document rounds.

theme_two.specific_theme: Stability and functionality of portal, app, and BankID login
theme_two.definition: Whether the portal, mobile app, and BankID login work reliably and offer sufficient features — covering wrong balances, upload crashes, login failures, and praised portal updates.

theme_three.specific_theme: Bokfør integration and automated direct debits
theme_three.definition: How well the bank connects with accounting software such as Bokfør and automates invoice posting and monthly direct debits without manual effort.

theme_four.specific_theme: Access to competent advisors and consistent contact persons
theme_four.definition: Customers' experience of staff competence and tailored advice, being able to reach a human (vs. chatbot), and speaking with the same contact person over time.

theme_five.specific_theme: Honoring credit promises and justifying rejections
theme_five.definition: Whether the bank stands by written or verbal credit commitments, sets honest eligibility expectations in marketing, and provides reasons when applications are declined.

theme_one.specific_theme: Interest rate and fee clarity in offers
theme_one.definition: Whether rates, fees, and total costs match what was advertised or offered, including hidden fees, effective rates, and break fees.

theme_two.specific_theme: Customer creditworthiness and invoice acceptance rules
theme_two.definition: Who qualifies for financing and credit lines, including rejections based on customer credit scores, B2C sales, and reduced credit limits at renewal.

theme_three.specific_theme: BankID login, automated data retrieval, and paperwork burden
theme_three.definition: Ease and speed of applying and getting started, including digital signing, automatic figure retrieval, and documentation volume.

theme_four.midlevel_theme: Invoice accuracy and account closure handling
theme_four.specific_theme: Erroneous invoices and delayed account termination
theme_four.definition: Correctness of billing (duplicate charges, wrong due dates, post-closure invoices) and the effort required to close an account.

theme_five.specific_theme: Responsiveness, helpfulness, and handover quality of contact persons
theme_five.definition: Access to and quality of human support, including chat availability outside hours, advisor turnover, and repeated information requests.

theme_one.specific_theme: Business credit and savings rate competitiveness
theme_one.definition: Comments on how high or competitive rates are, rate increases without explanation, and mismatches between calculator figures and final offers.

theme_two.specific_theme: Phone queues, advisor continuity, and staff helpfulness
theme_two.definition: Experiences with reaching support, waiting times, advisor handovers, and whether staff are helpful and professional.

theme_three.specific_theme: Time from application to decision and funds
theme_three.definition: Feedback on how fast and simple the application process is, from same-day payouts to multi-week delays versus promised timelines.

theme_four.specific_theme: Finding functions and self-service in the portal
theme_four.definition: How easy it is to navigate the website and portal, including terminating credit lines, changing account numbers, and giving accountant access.

theme_five.specific_theme: Adjustable terms, deferrals, and fit for business type
theme_five.definition: Whether products can be adjusted (credit limits, deferrals) and whether the bank understands the needs of different business sizes and industries.

theme_one.specific_theme: Waiting Time for Replies, Status Updates and Promised Callbacks
theme_one.definition: How quickly and dependably the bank answers emails, calls and status requests and honors promised follow-ups — from replies within minutes to eleven days of silence or callbacks that never come.

theme_two.specific_theme: Portal Uptime, BankID Login and Accounting Integration Reliability
theme_two.definition: How well the website, BankID login and accounting integrations work day to day, including self-service capability, portal hangs, failing integrations and how fast reported bugs get fixed.

theme_three.specific_theme: Advertised vs Granted Rates and Recurring Fee Charges
theme_three.definition: Perceived level and fairness of effective interest rates and fees, including gaps between advertised 'from' rates and actual offers and unexpected or duplicate monthly fees.

theme_four.definition: Friendliness, proactivity and problem-solving ability of advisors, and whether interactions feel genuinely advisory rather than pushy or sales-driven.

theme_five.specific_theme: Ease of Application, Credit Assessment Speed and Time to Payout
theme_five.definition: How simple and clear the application and terms are, how fast credit assessments are completed, and how quickly funds reach the customer's account.

theme_one.specific_theme: Reply speed and answer accuracy from support and advisors
theme_one.definition: How quickly, completely, and correctly support staff and advisors respond — including same-day answers, advisors knowing the business, half-answers, wrong information, and cases left open.

theme_two.specific_theme: Fee structure clarity, rate-change notice, and billing accuracy
theme_two.definition: How clearly fees, rates, rate increases, and binding periods are communicated, and whether invoices arrive with correct amounts — covering complex fee structures, surprise invoice items, short-notice rate hikes, and hidden lock-in terms.

theme_three.specific_theme: Portal performance, app availability, and accounting integration reliability
theme_three.definition: Availability, speed, and reliability of digital channels — the missing mobile app, slow portal, failing accounting-system integrations, untrustworthy balances, and granularity of user access controls.

theme_four.specific_theme: Time from approval or invoice sale to funds in account
theme_four.definition: How quickly loan and invoice-financing payouts reach the customer's account and the resulting effect on liquidity, payroll runs, and day-to-day operations.

theme_five.specific_theme: Loan amount caps, facility flexibility, and application simplicity
theme_five.definition: Whether credit limits, facility configurations (e.g., multiple overdrafts), and products like tax loans fit the company's size and seasonality, and how simple the application and setup process is.

theme_one.specific_theme: Rates versus fees and competitor pricing
theme_one.definition: How customers perceive the overall price of financing, including interest rates, fees, and comparisons with competitors.

theme_two.specific_theme: Openness about assessments, terms changes, and commitments
theme_two.definition: Whether customers feel the bank is open and honest about credit assessments, agreement terms, changes, and promises made in writing or advertising.

theme_three.definition: Experiences with advisors' knowledge of rules and the customer's business, proactive outreach, and whether follow-up communication actually happens.

theme_four.specific_theme: Digital application speed and self-service tools
theme_four.definition: How easy and fast it is to apply and manage the relationship digitally, including mobile applications, chatbot support, apps, and access to statements or invoice data.

theme_five.definition: Customer experiences with contractual lock-in, notice of binding periods, and costs or obstacles when trying to end the agreement early.
